program.title: Origami Craft
program.description: Discover the meditative art of paper folding that enhances focus, patience, and fine motor skills. Create beautiful creatures and objects while learning about Japanese culture and the mindfulness behind each precise fold.

items.title: Paper Magic Introduction
items.description: Learn the fascinating history of origami, discover different types of paper, and understand how simple folds create amazing shapes.

items.title: Classic Animal Creations
items.description: Fold beautiful cranes, frogs, butterflies, and other animals while developing precision and following sequential instructions.

items.title: Japanese Culture Corner
items.description: Explore the cultural significance of origami in Japanese traditions, learn basic Japanese words, and understand origami symbolism.

items.title: Mindful Folding Practice
items.description: Experience the calming, meditative aspects of origami that improve focus, patience, and present-moment awareness.

items.label: What to bring
items.value: Clean hands, water bottle, patience and enthusiasm

items.label: Take home
items.value: Origami creations collection, colored origami paper set, instruction booklet
